message: Review of feat/incremental-agent-instructions @ 27170e429f8d8058c189ba4c6e7963407a8a3e01: RequestChanges, review _reviews/27170e429f8d4058c189ba4c6e796340. Prior two correctness findings are fixed, and Client Release 390/390 + Server Release 95/95 pass. Two P2 findings: (1) implicit Ready->Working activation during ordinary read_file/get_git_status etc never triggers server invalidation; mutation may occur even when the requested operation fails, so other devices retain stale state; (2) every successful TaskWrite invalidates every agent in project, so frequent unrelated notifications/checkpoints undermine warm caches with repeated remote GitHub fetches. Recommend typed authoritative agent-state mutation/invalidation metadata (affected identities), not command-name guesses. Add end-to-end broadcast and fetch-count tests. No source changes, merge, or deployment authorized.
